cross_batch_memory_trajectory.mechanism: cross-batch verbal memory (lesson extraction after each batch)
cross_batch_memory_trajectory.relation_to_reflexion: Shinn et al. (2023) reflect on a failed attempt and retry the same task; here the lessons are carried to the next batch of different tasks. Reported as an extension, not a replication.
cross_batch_memory_trajectory.caveat: Descriptive. Batches differ in topics, so the across-batch column confounds any memory effect with topic difficulty. Within a batch, Planner selects lessons for tasks it judges relevant, so selected and unselected tasks are not randomized.
